reason: Loyalty tested and an arm given in the yard beat an exposition-heavy plot dump.
An investigation with a twist and a choice beats a boss fight against a machine.
Staff loyalty and a bodily cost beat a routine overwatch.
A personal stand at real cost beats a plain contract killing.
Revenge on a betrayer, with the cousin's call at the end, beats a run of errands.
Lived detail, loyalty and the arm's cost feel closer than a sprawling mystery.
